comment: T3.35 item 9: FFA solo-to... test. Local player is Tobor (the only non-CPU hero); 3 CPU rivals are spawned by the driver. Probe total summon/turret/mine counts over time — in a healthy solo-FFA with only the local Tobor casting wrench abilities, ALL active summons must belong to the local player (owner_peer_id == 1). If any summon has a different owner_peer_id, that means a CPU bot auto-cast a turret/mine and leaked it into the shared world — the bug this test is meant to catch. Also: the local player never auto-casts (input is driver-driven, not CpuBrain), so any turret/mine present in the world must have been placed by the local Tobor explicitly. We verify by checking owner_peer_id on every SummonEntity node in the tree.
